During the Vietnam War, the CIA flew secret missions from a remote jungle airstrip in Laos. In September 2026, that same airstrip reopened with a refurbished 2,000-metre runway and a new partner: China.
Beijing calls the Ban Keun facility a training centre for Laotian pilots. But look at the map. China sits on Vietnam's northern border. To the west, there's a Chinese-built airfield in Laos and a Chinese-funded naval base in Cambodia. To the east, there are Chinese-militarised islands in the South China Sea.
